environment: Linux, Xvfb 1440x900, Vulkan Lavapipe; X11 XTest input and MCPBridge.
scope: Created a part through the UI, selected YZ Plane in the browser, and invoked Start 2D Sketch with no other support click. MCPBridge reported an active healthy YZ sketch with DOF zero.
limitations: Fixed-coordinate driver is retained as a historical record, not a portable test.
The pre-existing bridge binary was not rebuilt from the checked-out source.
This run covers one origin plane; work planes and planar faces are not covered.
